mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goal ( couple_id, name, wedding_date, region, total_budget, groom_ratio, bride_ratio, created_at ) VALUES ( #{coupleId}, #{name}, #{weddingDate}, #{region}, #{totalBudget}, #{groomRatio}, #{brideRatio}, #{createdAt} )

INSERT INTO goal_item ( goal_id, category, target_amount, is_included, type ) VALUES
( #{goalId}, #{item.category}, #{item.targetAmount}, #{item.included}, #{item.type} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, couple_id, name, wedding_date, region, total_budget, groom_ratio, bride_ratio, status, is_main, requested_by, requested_at, created_at FROM goal WHERE couple_id = #{coupleId} ORDER BY is_main DESC, created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, couple_id, name, wedding_date, region, total_budget, groom_ratio, bride_ratio, status, is_main, requested_by, requested_at, created_at FROM goal WHERE couple_id = #{coupleId} ORDER BY id ASC FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE goal SET status = 'PENDING', requested_by = #{requestedBy}, requested_at = #{requestedAt} WHERE id = #{goalId} AND status = 'NORMAL' AND is_main = FALSE
UPDATE goal SET status = 'NORMAL', requested_by = NULL, requested_at = NULL WHERE id = #{goalId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND requested_by = #{requestedBy}
UPDATE goal SET status = 'NORMAL', requested_by = NULL, requested_at = NULL WHERE id = #{goalId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE goal SET status = 'NORMAL', is_main = FALSE, requested_by = NULL, requested_at = NULL WHERE couple_id = #{coupleId} AND id != #{excludedGoalId} AND is_main = TRUE
UPDATE goal SET status = 'CONFIRMED', is_main = TRUE, requested_by = NULL, requested_at = NULL WHERE id = #{goalId} AND status = 'PENDING' AND is_main = FALSE
